name: חיבור שברים רציונליים – מכנים ריבועיים עם גורם משותף (באנגלית)
questiontext:
Express the following as a single fraction: \[ {{CT:0}}. \]
(Hint: Try factorising the fractions.)

[[input:ans]] [[validation:ans]]
generalfeedback:
When adding or subtracting algebraic fractions, just using the general rule can create alot more work if the denominators of the fractions have common factors. In this example, if we factorise the denominators we obtain:
\[ \frac{{CT:1}}{{CT:2}}+\frac{{CT:3}}{{CT:4}}. \]
It is clear that the factor \({{CT:5}}\) is common in both denominators and so there is no need for our common denominator to contain this factor twice. Therefore, we take the common denominator \({{CT:6}}\):
\[ \frac{{CT:7}}{{CT:6}}+\frac{{CT:8}}{{CT:6}} = {{CT:9}}. \]
